checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-ai-verify-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: add --expect-hash gates -> AI workflow guide and tests -> docs, ADR and gates

impact_assessment.why: AI/CI clients need pinned deterministic outcomes, not only repeated hashes; a guide makes the discovery-to-visual-diff flow explicit.
impact_assessment.benefits: One command can assert a known result and fail on drift; the AI workflow is reviewable end to end.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new CLI flag; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: expected hashes are explicit inputs, never hidden defaults.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Test match/mismatch exit codes, keep simulation GL-free, document the format and run all gates.

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-ai-gate-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: PNG reader + pixel diff -> CLI --diff-out integration -> tests, guide, ADR and gates

impact_assessment.why: A model needs a visual diff artifact and changed-pixel evidence, not only report hashes.
impact_assessment.benefits: Baseline comparisons produce a diff PNG plus region/statistics that an AI or human can inspect.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new PNG reader and --diff-out; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: diff files are generated, never baseline mutations.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Round-trip/filter tests, dimension validation, non-zero exit on image change and temp artifacts.

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-ai-vision-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: dependency-free bitmap font + 2D canvas -> GL overlay renderer + HUD/pause/help in Engine and --ui/--no-ui CLI -> tests, docs, ADR and gates

impact_assessment.why: The engine has an AI-facing contract but a person running the window has no in-engine HUD, help or pause state; a game-agnostic UI layer closes that gap.
impact_assessment.benefits: Windowed runs show game name, status, FPS, frame, resolution, controls and pause state; headless captures can include the same overlay for UI analysis.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new --ui/--no-ui flags and Engine ui parameter; dependency: numpy/PyOpenGL already declared; concurrency: none; state: UI is presentation-only and never mutates the game.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure canvas/font unit tests, GL visibility test via differing captures, CLI usage tests and the full 6/6 project gate.

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-human-ui-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: pure PauseMenu state machine + hit-testable buttons -> mouse/keyboard input, cursor release and Engine actions -> tests, docs, ADR and gates

impact_assessment.why: A human UI needs a real pause menu with discoverable actions, not only a static banner; clicking and keyboard selection make the engine usable without memorizing keys.
impact_assessment.benefits: P pauses into a clickable Resume/Hide HUD/Quit menu; the released cursor allows mouse use, and the same menu state is unit-testable without GL.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ActionState gains mouse_clicked, new confirm binding, Engine menu actions; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: menu selection is presentation state only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure menu tests, overlay hitbox tests, InputMap/action round-trip tests, and the full 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-ui-menu-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: optional GameModule.draw_ui(canvas, state) hook -> Engine composition + describe capability -> tests, docs, ADR and gates

impact_assessment.why: An engine-only HUD cannot show game state; games need a supported way to draw health/score/custom panels with the same dependency-free UI toolkit.
impact_assessment.benefits: External games can add HUDs and panels without forking the engine, while the five required GameModule operations stay unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: optional draw_ui hook and describe capability; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: the game draws into a per-frame Canvas, never the engine's menu.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Hook/no-hook capture test, describe test, hidden-overlay behavior documented and the full 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-game-ui-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: Canvas text/button metadata -> schema-2 UI report + --start-paused -> UI diff, tests, docs, assets, ADR and gates

impact_assessment.why: Human UI pixels are now real, but AI reports cannot see HUD labels, buttons, selection or pause state; UI regressions remain pixel-only.
impact_assessment.benefits: Reports expose structured UI elements for AI/UI analysis, and baseline diffs can name added/removed/changed labels and buttons.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: report schema 1->2 with an optional ui field, new --start-paused flag; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: UI metadata is read-only presentation data.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Backward-compatible comparison of missing ui, schema tests, deterministic headless UI reports and the full 6/6 gate.
